column4: Calendar-gated, not dialect-gated, and unrelated to this PR: `nextRun` iterates minute-by-minute over a fixed 1-year window from a hardcoded `time.Date(2025, 2, 28, ...)`, and 2025 has no Feb 29, so the window finds no match and the test calls t.Skip. Already attributed under scripts/skip-ledger.d/multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv for job multi-db/plugins, which explicitly predicted this test "would skip in ci.yml's test-go/plugins too, under that job's own __UNATTRIBUTED__ budget" -- this line gives it that job's own name instead of relying on the legacy allowance. Measured by NAME: go test ./plugins/scheduledbackup/... -run TestNextRun_Feb29NonLeapYear -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one skip, with no DSN of any kind set.
